title: KM VMS 0.8.5 — Safe Current Database Restore and Recovery
summary: Adds product-grade restoration of the current KM VMS database with verified pre-restore backup, isolated writers, automatic rollback, truthful progress and recorder recovery proof.
changelog: Enables authenticated current-database restore from eligible product-owned backup artifacts.
Requires integrity, compatibility, temporary-restore, actor-access, capacity and maintenance-conflict preflight.
Creates and verifies a persistent pre-restore backup before changing the working database.
Runs restore through the external helper and one-shot executor only after API and recorder writer isolation is proven.
Automatically rolls back controlled failures and reports recovery-required when rollback cannot be proven.
Requires a fresh recorder instance and heartbeat before successful restore or rollback completion.
Reconciles API and recorder independently after partial or unknown writer-stop failures without starting database mutation.
Shows clear typed confirmation, bounded progress and truthful restore results while keeping video archives outside DB restore.
Aligns Settings open actions and restores compact equal support-report buttons without changing their existing behavior.
